info.title: VehicleMarket API
info.description: Indian used-vehicle marketplace API — buy & sell vehicles, requests, chat, CMS and admin. All endpoints are under `/api/v1` except `/sitemap.xml`. Authenticate with a Bearer access token (from `/auth/login`); a refresh token is also set as the `vm_refresh` httpOnly cookie.
